items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: We played a few jobs together with different bands, you know, with Lewister Maine, you see.

ctx.x: Did you ever know little dad, the banjo? Oh, dad, yes, indeed.

We played a few jobs together with different bands, you know, with Lewister Maine, you see. I played with dad with Lewister Maine, just sitting in for Willigan, like Willigan couldn't play. That was Lewister's drummer, Willigan. What was his name? James Willing.
